correctness.rationale: The exact repeated-index vector field reduces to Im[(A Z1+B Z2 conjugate(Z1))e^{-i theta_i}], A=NK1/(N-1), B=K2. Subtracting the two group velocities gives dot Delta=-sin Delta[A+B((n-m)^2+4nm cos Delta)/N^2]. Any interior non-antipodal lock has positive tangential derivative. Differentiating the original full j,l double sum yields internal eigenvalues -(n-m)(A+B)/N and +(n-m)(A+B)/N (each with respective block dimension minus one), and relative eigenvalue A+B[1-8nm/N^2]. Both blocks size >=2 imply a positive internal eigenvalue except equal blocks, whose zero modes admit an explicitly unstable invariant symmetric split (+u,-u). Only one-solitary antipodal clusters can attract; solving lambda_rel<0 gives N=3,4,5,6 and the stated exact strict gain thresholds. Positive cubic drift of Delta-pi at equality excludes Lyapunov stability there. At synchrony eigenvalues -(A+B). Independently differentiated every original repeated-index pair and triple term on six rational finite antipodal partitions and checked the eigenvalue formulas. The six checks are corroborative; the analytic spectrum and boundary sign prove the unbounded N claim.
